## Architecture Guidance Metadata

```yaml
guidance_id: 'GUID-SEC-<CAPABILITY>-<TYPE>-SBB-4.N.NN'
guidance_name: '<Name>: Solution Building Block'
guidance_type: 'solution-building-block'
sbb_type: '<composite / component>'
realized_abb: '<GUID-SEC-*-N.N.NN>'           # Component ABB this SBB realizes
paired_rad: '<GUID-SEC-*-RAD-3.N.NN>'         # Reference Architecture Document this SBB implements
parent_vision: '<GUID-SEC-*-VISION-0.N.NN>'
adm_phase: 'Phase E-F'
category: 'security'
version: '0.1.0'
status: 'draft'
applicability: 'enterprise'
product_name: '<Vendor Product / Open Source Project Name>'
product_version: '<e.g., 2.x, 4.1.x — use the minimum supported version>'
tags: ['security', '<capability-tag>', 'solution-building-block', 'phase-e', 'phase-f']
author: '<Author Name>'
```

---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase E–F (Opportunities & Solutions / Migration Planning)**: This document is a **Solution Building Block (SBB)**. SBBs are physical, product-specific implementations that realize the logical capabilities defined in a parent Architecture Building Block (ABB). Unlike ABBs — which are technology-agnostic — SBBs reference specific products, versions, vendor capabilities, and configuration requirements.
>
> SBBs are authoritative inputs to project-level solution design, procurement decisions, and platform engineering runbooks. They SHALL NOT define new architectural requirements; all normative requirements are inherited from the parent ABB and Reference Architecture Document (RAD).

### Pre-deployment Validation

All items below SHALL pass before this SBB is deployed to production:

- [ ] Configuration has been validated against Required Configuration table above
- [ ] No Prohibited Configuration values are present
- [ ] Network flows have been tested and confirmed (not assumed)
- [ ] Service account permissions validated as least-privilege
- [ ] All secrets stored in approved secret manager — no plaintext credentials in config or environment
- [ ] Audit log forwarding confirmed to SIEM with test events verified at destination
- [ ] CIS Benchmark scan completed; exceptions documented and approved
- [ ] High availability configuration tested (failover verified)
- [ ] Compliance evidence artifacts collected and stored in audit evidence repository
